problem: A correct native navigation click can be followed by an unfinished document. The original Browser.observe retries ten null READ_STATE results; the unchanged Agent may make a second observe call. One exposed pandas attempt exhausted both calls while an older successful attempt recovered on its thirteenth read. These traces do not contain per-read wall clocks and do not prove a particular settling duration would recover the failed attempt.

change.parent: Exact composed-visible-text-v3; no v4/v5/v6 menu or executor changes
change.observe: Retry only the exact native StalePage('Document is navigating') within a cooperative five-second target. Accept the first complete snapshot that finishes within that target; reject a late snapshot and record actual elapsed time. Preserve other exception identities.
change.timing: The target includes inherited readiness, native observation, screenshot and diagnostic capture. Synchronous CDP calls can overshoot. Five seconds is not a hard cancellation deadline, and two Agent observe calls are not a hard ten-second operation bound.
change.unchanged: Native browser_operation, Agent, freshness, action execution, history, policy/helper calls, questions, cases, judge and sixteen-decision budget
change.diagnostics: Bounded per-observe records and an attempt sidecar. Native operation timings combine its CDP work; they are not individual CDP or screenshot timings. Diagnostic failures retain the primary error and cannot produce a successful observation.
